notes: Account background: founded 2018, provides enterprise RAG orchestration for legal and financial customers. Heavy on compliance and per-tenant data controls.
Primary pain: scale + cost. Running multiple legacy vector stores; want unified routing, cheaper per-query math for high-QPS retrieval+rerank.
POC scope agreed: ingest 10M docs, run emb+approx search -> top-50 rerank (cross-encoder) flow, measure p50/p90 end-to-end latency and cost per query.

Model preferences: prefer open embeddings (OpenCLIP-ish embedding stack) for cost and auditability; willing to test Redwood-verified model variants. Reranker: candidate for smaller cross-encoder on GPU or batched CPU quantized path.
Vector DB preference: primary is pgvector (in-house Postgres fleet) + Elastic hybrid for text filters; evaluating Pinecone/Weaviate connectors for high-cardinality metadata and re-ingestion speed.

Connector requirements called out by infra team: CDC/incremental sync, schema-on-write for metadata facets, soft-deletes propagation, near-real-time 1-2s visibility for updates, bulk backfill tooling, connector monitoring metrics (lag, errors, throughput).

Latency/throughput targets quoted by customer: 150-300ms P50 for simple doc-search, end-to-end rerank <= 450ms P50 for <2k qps; long-term target 5k qps with batching and routing to lower-cost variants.
Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query (emb+search+rerank) <$0.003 at scale; strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching, quantization) to hit numbers.
Security notes: must support SSO/SAML, tenant-level KMS, audit logs retained 7+ years for audit customers; data residency: EU and US segmented clusters.

Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-10): 'We need predictable unit economics before committing to reserved capacity. If you can show a consistent 2x cost improvement vs current stack at our 30M monthly queries, we can move to Dedicated.'
AE notes: Redwood se to demo PGVector connector + hybrid Elastic filter flow; show canary routing to smaller embedding model and fallback policy for capacity pressure.
Action items captured: Redwood to provide baseline perf matrix (3 connector options), estimated Dedicated config cost, and security questionnaire answers by 2026-03-05.
Internal: prepare a short video walkthrough of rerank pipeline (vector -> ann -> cross-encoder) and a sample Jira we can use to track connector integration (RAG-1122).
